title: Two El Ninos compared: 1997-1998 and 2015-2016
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), compare how the 1997-1998 and 2015-2016 El Nino events affected coastal temperature and chlorophyll, and determine why their imprints differed, including the role of the warm anomaly that began in 2014.
